Air.source: dry air composition of PNNL-15870 Rev. 1 (N, O, Ar, trace C)

CuCrZr.source: ITER Materials Properties Handbook, CuCrZr-IG (Cu-0.8Cr-0.08Zr class); trace elements omitted

EUROFER97.source: Lindau et al., Fusion Eng. Des. 75-79 (2005) 989, EUROFER97 specification: nominal alloying plus specified impurity elements

Glass-fibre/epoxy insulation.source: coordinator task list: E-glass (Si, O, Ca, Al, Mg, B) with epoxy (C, H, N, O)

Heavy water.source: D2O; deuterium is the H2 nuclide of element H

Inconel 718.source: ASTM B637 / AMS 5662 UNS N07718 composition table (B, P, S, Ta trace limits omitted)

Ordinary Portland concrete.source: H, O, Si, Ca, Al, Fe, Na, K, Mg as in the ordinary-concrete composition of PNNL-15870 Rev. 1 (Compendium of Material Composition Data for Radiation Transport Modeling); trace C and S added as the task specifies

REBCO tape.source: coordinator task list: (Y,Gd)Ba2Cu3O7 with Ag and Cu layers on Hastelloy C-276 substrate (Ni, Mo, Cr, Fe, W, Co, Mn per ASTM B575 UNS N10276 major elements)

SS316L.source: ASTM A240/A240M UNS S31603 chemical-composition table (Fe, Cr, Ni, Mo balance and alloying; Mn, Si, C, N, P, S specified limits)

V-4Cr-4Ti.source: alloy name; interstitial O, N, C impurities not listed
